pages.text: LuminaPV Manufacturing LLC is seeking a $125 million senior debt facility to finance a 3.0 GW domestic solar module manufacturing facility in Nevada. The borrower expects the facility to reach commercial operations in Q4 2027 and has secured a 10-year offtake with SunBright Energy for 82% of planned output.

Key risks include construction execution, delayed interconnection approvals for a backup export line, and commodity input volatility. Management states that the primary facility does not require a new executed interconnection agreement for initial operations, but the backup export line remains pending utility approval.
The EPC contractor will deliver a turnkey module assembly facility with nameplate annual throughput of 3.0 GW. Mechanical completion is targeted for July 31, 2027.
Target commercial operation date is September 30, 2027. Delay liquidated damages apply if commercial operation is not achieved by October 31, 2027.
Base case minimum DSCR is 1.42x in Q1 2028. Downside minimum DSCR is 1.18x in Q2 2028. The lender case assumes a debt service reserve account sized at six months of scheduled principal and interest.
The project reaches positive net income in Year 2 following commercial operations. EBITDA turns positive in Q2 2028 once contracted throughput exceeds 68% utilization.

The borrower shall maintain a minimum quarterly DSCR of 1.20x once the facility reaches commercial operation. Additional indebtedness is prohibited without lender consent, except for purchase-money obligations under $3 million.

Prior to initial funding, the borrower must deliver executed material project documents, evidence of offtake effectiveness, and evidence that all material permits have been obtained. The interconnection agreement for the backup export line may be delivered after closing subject to a post-closing covenant.

SunBright Energy has entered a 10-year offtake agreement covering 82% of annual production subject to price collar adjustments. SunBright carries an internal BBB- equivalent credit assessment from the sponsor's rating framework.

Open diligence items include utility confirmation for the backup export line, final independent engineer report, commodity hedging policy, and cybersecurity controls review. No executed backup export interconnection agreement was present in the data room as of March 15, 2026.
